title: Tailnet operator
description: Source-prepared dashboard; not live-tested or exported from Grafana. Operator status, observed Headscale nodes and agent traffic. Gateway and TLS certificate metrics are not implemented.

__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus scraping the operator and optional agents

panels.title: 1. Resource overview
panels.description: Current persisted status. Only resources with a current Ready condition emit readiness; Tailnet does not. No data is not proof of health.

panels.title: Resource Ready
panels.description: 1 means Ready, 0 means not Ready. Minimum across exporters preserves a failure during overlapping replica observations. Filters apply to CR identity, not the operator scrape namespace; honorLabels is enabled in the bundled ServiceMonitor.

panels.title: Scope and interpretation
panels.description: Explains filtering and evidence limits for every row.

options.content: **Source-prepared, not Grafana live-tested/exported.** Namespace/kind filters apply where those labels exist. Tailnet filters apply only to families carrying `tailnet`; conditions, nodes, targets, exposes and agent series do not carry it. Agent namespace/pod labels come from scrape metadata, not metric payloads. No node IPs, user identities, credentials or policy hashes are metric labels. Missing series can mean missing discovery, blocked scraping or an unobserved condition, not health.

panels.title: 2. Conditions
panels.description: Active condition reasons and reconcile errors. Historical reasons are retained at zero and filtered out here.

panels.title: Current condition reasons
panels.description: A value of 1 identifies the active reason, including False and Unknown conditions; it does not itself mean success. No tailnet filter: this family lacks that label.

targets.expr: max by (kind, namespace, name, type, reason) (tailnet_resource_condition{namespace=~"$namespace",kind=~"$kind"}) == 1

panels.title: Reconcile errors / second
panels.description: Controller-runtime errors for tailnet controllers. This is operator-wide, independent of namespace, tailnet and kind filters.

panels.title: 3. Egress
panels.description: Per-target route state and egress registration key lifetime. These families have namespace/name labels but no tailnet or kind labels.

panels.title: Active target route reasons
panels.description: One active reason per target. Present represents an empty successful route reason. Historical reasons at zero are excluded; this is not an end-to-end traffic probe.

panels.title: Egress auth-key lifetime
panels.description: Seconds until pre-auth key expiry. Negative means expired; expiry alone does not establish that a registered node is offline.

panels.title: 4. Ingress
panels.description: Agent-reported backend reachability and registration key lifetime. TLS and gateway-specific telemetry remain placeholders, not fabricated queries.

panels.title: Expose backend reachable
panels.description: 1 means the agent can reach the exposed backend, 0 means it cannot. This does not prove public TLS or gateway reachability. Namespace filter only.

panels.title: Ingress auth-key lifetime
panels.description: Seconds until pre-auth key expiry, not node session lifetime. Namespace filter only.

panels.title: Gateway / TLS telemetry — planned
panels.description: Explicit placeholder for unimplemented gateway and TLS metric families.

options.content: Gateway request/error metrics and TLS certificate expiry are **not emitted in this slice**. No query is provided. Backend reachability does not substitute for gateway/TLS validation.

panels.title: 5. Policy
panels.description: Policy convergence, generated entries and API write behavior. Tailnet filter applies; namespace/kind resource filters do not. Policy kind means tags, grants or routes.

panels.title: Policy pending
panels.description: 1 only when Apply mode has a nonempty rendered hash different from the applied hash. Stable InSync remains 0 even when applied timestamp is old. Hashes are never labels.

panels.title: Generated policy entries
panels.description: Counts of generated tags, grants and routes in persisted status. Large drops may be intended resource deletions; review rather than automatically roll back.

panels.title: Policy write latency p95
panels.description: SetPolicy duration including failures. Histograms need traffic; an idle policy can legitimately show no data.

panels.title: Apply errors / 30 minutes
panels.description: Failed or rejected policy writes, aggregated across operator restarts/replicas using counter-aware increase.

panels.title: Route approval replays / hour
panels.description: New routes successfully approved by replay, counted per route rather than per API request.

panels.title: 6. Headscale API
panels.description: Bounded API operation labels: tailnet, method, path_template and code. No node IDs, IP addresses or user identities. Tailnet filter only.

panels.title: API operations / second
panels.description: Operation rate by HTTP status; code 0 means no response (transport failure), not an HTTP status. Path templates exclude dynamic identities.

panels.title: API latency p95
panels.description: Latency includes failed operations. A quiet operation may have no quantile until enough samples are scraped.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (tailnet, method, path_template, le) (rate(tailnet_headscale_api_duration_seconds_bucket{tailnet=~"$tailnet"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Working API key lifetime
panels.description: Seconds until working API key expiry. Rotation should increase this value; negative means expired.

panels.title: 7. Agent traffic and node observations
panels.description: Agent traffic uses the optional PodMonitor on health TCP/9080 and scrape namespace/pod labels, not tailnet/kind. External scrapers require site-owned NetworkPolicy access. Node observations use operator metrics with resource kind/namespace/name labels.

panels.title: Active proxied connections
panels.description: Active target/expose connections. Agent pod namespace can differ from the originating CR namespace (egress runs in the operator namespace). No tailnet/kind filtering.

panels.title: Proxied bytes / second
panels.description: TCP counts accepted-connection bytes. HTTP includes TLS wire overhead; this is not HTTP payload size. Directions are to_target/from_target. Namespace filter uses the agent pod namespace.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod, target, expose, direction) (rate(tailnet_agent_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Agent dial latency p95
panels.description: Dial latency includes health probes, not only accepted application traffic. Namespace filter uses scrape metadata; target/expose identify the configured endpoint, not its address.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, pod, target, expose, le) (rate(tailnet_agent_dial_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Headscale node online
panels.description: 1 means a matching Headscale node is online; 0 means a successful node listing found none online. An absent series means no current observation, not offline. Minimum across exporters preserves an offline observation. Resource namespace/kind filters only; no tailnet label.

panels.title: Headscale node last-seen age
panels.description: Seconds since the selected Headscale node's last-seen Unix timestamp, using the oldest observation across exporters. Unknown timestamps are absent. Headscale last-seen age is not an end-to-end traffic probe or proof that an online node is offline. Resource namespace/kind filters only; no tailnet label.
